info.title: Basis API
info.description:
Basis cost segregation API.

**Authentication.** Every `/v1` route needs `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>`.
A user is created on first sight, in no organization: firms are invite-only.
`GET /v1/me` lists your firms and the invitations waiting for your verified email; until
you accept one, the study list and study creation answer 403 `no-firm`.

**Authorization.** Studies belong to organizations (firms). A study or firm you are not a
member of is 404, not 403; one you can see but whose action needs a higher role
(viewer < engineer < owner) is 403. Owners administer their firm under
`/v1/orgs/{org_id}`: members, roles and invitations.

**Idempotency.** `POST` and `DELETE` need an `Idempotency-Key` header (a UUID is
recommended). Retrying with the same key and body replays the stored response with
`Idempotent-Replayed: true` for 24 hours; the same key with a different body is 422; a
retry while the first request is still running is 409. Keys are scoped per user.

**Rate limits.** Per user, by default 240 reads and 60 mutations per minute; 429 with
`Retry-After`.

**Errors.** Every 4xx/5xx is `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457): `type`, `title`,
`status`, `detail`, `instance`, `request_id` (equal to the `X-Request-Id` response
header), and `errors` (one entry per field) on validation failures.

**Limits.** JSON bodies up to 1 MiB (413 beyond). Files are never sent to the API: request
a signed URL, upload to it, then confirm.

post.summary: Approve or reject the current review stage
post.description: Records the decision and queues it for the workflow (202). A stage the study is not at, or a revision that is not its current one, is 409; so is a gate the workflow has not opened yet (`gate-not-open`: the study is at the stage but `processing` or `failed`). Each correction's `entity_type` must be one the stage accepts (appraisal_review: extraction_field; rooms_review: room, photo_room; components_review: component, room_component, photo; assets_review: asset; a study whose `components_gate` is false has the single rooms_review: room, component, room_component, photo) and its `entity_id` must exist in the study at the decided revision (a photo or photo_room: a photo document of the study; a room_component: the room it adds a component to); a `photo_room` `after` is exactly a `room_id` of that revision; a `component` `count` must be a whole number from 1, and a `room_component` `after` a taxonomy `label` with a `count` (optional `material`, `attachment` from their vocabularies); otherwise 422 with one `errors` entry per offending correction, located at `["body", "corrections", <index>, "entity_type" | "entity_id" | "after"]`.

post.summary: Add an engineer's selection (a box, a tap or a candidate) at the components review
post.description: A `box` resolves to the stored instance of its label it overlaps at IoU >= 0.5; with none, SAM 3 is prompted with the label's phrases and the box and the instance overlapping the box best at IoU >= 0.5 with score >= 0.5 is stored with its outline (`mask_source: sam_box_prompt`), else the box alone (`none`, `mask_reason` says why; a failed or timed-out call never fails the add). A tap (`point`) resolves to the stored instance under it, 422 when there is none (draw a box). A `candidate` names a stored instance by id. An uncounted candidate becomes a manual instance with its outline (201, `mask_source: candidate`). A selection that is, or covers at intersection over the smaller >= 0.5, a counted instance of its label adds nothing (200, `created: false`, `duplicate_of`) unless `allow_duplicate`. Only while the study waits at `components_review` (`rooms_review` when its `components_gate` is false), on its current revision, once the photo's localization is recorded (409 otherwise; `localization-pending` while SAM 3 still runs).
